desc: The Burris Scout 2.75x20mm fixed magnification magnifies everything almost 3 times, with no zoom. In applications where forward-mounted optics are required, the Scout has been the optic of choice for scout rifles, slug guns, muzzleloaders and even big bore magnums. It offers long eye-relief, wide field-of-view, fully multi-coated lenses, tight mechanical tolerances, steel on steel adjustments, fixed focal length, elevation and windage adjustment is 140" @ 100 yds and a Heavy Plex reticle. The Scout Scope offers ultra-fast target acquisition with both eyes open.
